name: Smuggler's Bargain
summary: An Eastsea pirate offers Friz Frazzlespark a bargain to leave her business alone. You carry his message back to her in Powderfuse Port.

sections.title: A Captain's Offer
sections.body: Friz Frazzlespark has drawn the Eastsea pirates' attention, and one of them offers to keep his crew from interfering with her business. In return, he proposes a profitable arrangement. You carry his message back to Friz in Powderfuse Port, where she will hear who claims command.

sections.title: Friz's Lesson
sections.body: Friz answers the pirate's offer with a warning about the cost of crossing her. Her words leave the bargain's terms in doubt.

faq.q: What does the pirate offer Friz?
faq.answer: An Eastsea pirate offers to keep his crew from interfering with Friz's business and proposes a profitable arrangement.

faq.q: Who do I report back to?
faq.answer: You return to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.

faq.q: What message does the captain send?
faq.answer: He wants Friz to know that a new captain is in charge and foresees a profitable relationship.
Friz questions who the captain is, and the message does not name him.
